# Tellcraft

> AI-powered website builder. Describe your idea in natural language — Tellcraft builds, tests, and deploys a professional website in minutes.

## What Tellcraft Does

- Accepts natural language descriptions of websites users want to build
- AI proactively clarifies requirements through multi-round conversation
- Generates production-ready code using Next.js, React, and TypeScript
- Deploys to cloud automatically with a unique URL
- Supports template-based and freeform website creation
- Website categories: SaaS, Landing Page, E-commerce, Portfolio, Blog, Event, Booking System, Admin Dashboard

## How It Works

1. Describe your idea in natural language — like chatting with a friend
2. AI identifies ambiguities and proactively asks questions to clarify requirements
3. Complete system specifications presented for your confirmation
4. AI generates frontend, backend, and database code with automated testing
5. One-click deploy to cloud — receive your unique URL, website ready immediately

## Key Facts

- No coding required — anyone can build professional websites through conversation
- Free tier available — start building immediately
- Average time from idea to live site: under 24 hours
- 100% code ownership — export full source code anytime
- Tech stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, PostgreSQL
- Supports English and Traditional Chinese (zh-TW)
- BDD (Behavior-Driven Development) specification-driven for complex projects

## Target Users

- Startups validating product concepts quickly without hiring developers
- E-commerce sellers building brand websites and online stores
- Freelancers and agencies multiplying project capacity with AI assistance
- SMBs pursuing digital transformation without technical expertise
- Independent developers prototyping ideas rapidly

## Comparison with Traditional Development

| Aspect | Traditional Development | Tellcraft |
|--------|------------------------|-----------|
| Coding skills required | Yes | No |
| Development time | Weeks to months | Hours to days |
| Cost of requirement changes | High (requires redevelopment) | Low (modify through conversation) |
| Team size | Multi-person | One person |
| Code ownership | Depends on contract | 100% owned |
